reader.requirement: At 85 END-WRITE ends the scope of a relative WRITE, so a WRITE with INVALID KEY / NOT INVALID KEY inside IF or inside another WRITE's INVALID KEY is closed there and the following statements belong to the enclosing scope; END-WRITE without a WRITE is refused.

edition-consulted.switches: GateFilePhrase (WRITE FILE, later edition) and GateRetryLockPlace (RETRY / LOCK, 2002+); neither is touched by END-WRITE, and a WRITE without those phrases passes at every edition

reader.notes: The scope terminator is purely syntactic (ANTLR writeStatement with END_WRITE?); the nested inner WRITE takes the nearest END-WRITE as the rule requires.
